result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is the best all-around payment processor**\. However, if you're already using Shopify, I'd recommend Shopify Payments instead.

The best choice depends on your ecommerce platform, transaction volume, and whether you sell internationally.

## My top 5 recommendations

![CPGIO - Multichannel eCommerce Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/PjgYNLsLO5kyHaLbRGf_vEGDklf86yBgljtBg18t7Dvw-WgJwtAR87t17RVnZQNRleNsnU2jfdTsx-hJkwGMn58MvL69dhGg6Mz4413HP_F8ItDmZVpm38tgVXpxLOBbHgVAgnhtZKjtJgc5PKyPg4Dx8NXHfNqw_93O-hccPsS0BrwP9sqrs9aaI_I6CV7n?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Standard US online card rate: 2.9% + \$0.30
- No standard monthly processing fee
- Excellent fraud protection and integrations
- Supports subscriptions and international payments

Best for WooCommerce, custom websites, and independent online stores.

[Stripe pricing](https://stripe.com/pricing)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Basic online card rate around 2.9% + \$0.30
- Integrated directly into Shopify
- No additional Shopify third-party transaction fee when using it
- Easy refunds, reporting, and payouts

Best if your store is already built on Shopify.

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/payments)

---

![PayPal Review: Is It the Right Payment Solution for You?](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Tb4l2sAZiezYqSwWI257xsR6Xu0StrpvRBfglhUmoX3ym_BKZCv57DPk0af1Bp6xi5ybj92wq6prLOQZ307hFyJz2zbjdBN1HYy64DdJYUxgA51W2YSY0pG7XDgLKYG9Y_6a9G9miy6Oqt5DjWtXQyteBeRgO2-fjh76KKoiZnmx1ygYUuHA2W6jRY5_Ji16?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- PayPal Checkout commonly around 3.49% + \$0.49
- Familiar and trusted by many shoppers
- Supports PayPal and eligible alternative payment methods
- Easy to add to most ecommerce platforms

Best as an additional checkout option to give customers more flexibility.

[PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/us/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Free starting plan
- Online processing around 3.3% + \$0.30 on the free plan
- Excellent inventory and point-of-sale integration
- Convenient if you also sell in person

Best for businesses selling both online and offline.

[Square Payments](https://squareup.com/us/en/payments)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Helcim**

- Interchange-plus pricing
- No standard monthly fee
- Potential savings as transaction volume increases
- Good reporting and business tools

Best for stores processing enough transactions to benefit from customized pricing.

[Helcim pricing](https://www.helcim.com/pricing/)

US pricing estimates; actual fees vary by card type, payment method, plan, and other factors. ## What I'd personally recommend

For a small online store starting out\:

- **Primary processor\:** Stripe or Shopify Payments.
- **Additional checkout option\:** PayPal.
- **Avoid initially\:** Expensive monthly processing contracts unless your transaction volume justifies them.

Offering multiple familiar payment methods can help reduce checkout abandonment.
